cohort: The study included 289 patients who underwent single-blastocyst transfer within fresh IVF/(early rescue)ICSI-ET treatment cycles.
finding: There were no significant differences in clinical pregnancy rate, live birth rate, or any birth outcomes and neonatal status between patients receiving early blastocyst transfer and those receiving fully expanded blastocyst transfer.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in the mode of delivery between the early blastocyst group and the fully expanded blastocyst group.
